mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash, enabled, password_changed_at, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM app_user ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user(username, password_hash, enabled, password_changed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{enabled}, #{passwordChangedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET last_login_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
